pages.text: Spell power for these spells is 8 at level 1, plus 3 for each level after, multiplied by your Iron's spell power and school power bonuses from gear and attributes.
pages.title: Spell Power and Damage

pages.text: Each spell's damage is a multiple of that power, shown on its page and in its tooltip. Magic resistance and Iron's own damage rules apply as usual.

Physical spells (Balgrant, Doragate and the golem fist) count as stronger against defensive magic, as in the anime: defensive barriers are weak to mass.$(br2)Terrain and barriers block beams. Spells never grief terrain unless noted.
